record.tooling: No public API or CLI found. Account-gated workspace product (quantum-safe E2EE suite: Transfer + Drive + Notes + Messaging).
record.chaining: 2 free workspaces x 2 GB. Trivial volume, and the transfer allowance and Drive storage are separate small pools. Nothing here multiplies.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap: 2 GB transfer, 7-day retention on free. The 2 GB Drive is permanent but tiny. Workspace count (2) is the multiplication lever and it is too small to matter.
record.reliability_note: Its marketing page claims 'No size limits' for Transfer while its own pricing page says 2 GB. A direct contradiction within the same site. Trust the pricing page.
